title: The threshold for fractional clique decompositions of random hypergraphs, via matrix scaling
summary: Let $δ^*_{k,r}$ be the fractional $K_r^{(k)}$-decomposition threshold in minimum codegree. For fixed $k\ge2$, $r\ge k+1$ and $\varepsilon>0$, we prove that every $n$-vertex $k$-uniform hypergraph $G$ with minimum codegree at least $(δ^*_{k,r}+\varepsilon)n$ admits, with high probability, a fractional $K_r^{(k)}$-decomposition after retaining each edge independently with probability $p \ge C(\log n/n^{r-k})^{1/(\binom{r}{k}-1)}$. The bound on $p$ is sharp up to a constant factor, confirming the conjectured threshold order in the graph case. The proof develops a probabilistic matrix-scaling…
